common.restricted: Your account is restricted. Contact support if you think this is a mistake.

onboarding.languageNote: You can change this anytime in your profile.

auth.tagline: Adelaide's local marketplace — in your language
auth.codeSent: Check your email for a 6-digit code
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts — please wait a bit and try again.
auth.requiredBody: Browsing is open to everyone — signing in lets you post, chat, favourite and make offers.

profileSetup.title: Set up your profile
profileSetup.nationalityNote: Shown on your profile. Buyers can filter by it — or leave it empty.
profileSetup.photoHint: Tap to add a profile photo
profileSetup.locationMismatch: You seem to be in {{suburb}} — tap to use it
profileSetup.nameCooldown: You can change your nickname once every 30 days.
profileSetup.nameCooldownUntil: You can change it again on {{date}}.

home.empty: No listings yet — be the first to post!

profile.deleteAccountConfirm: This permanently removes your account, listings, chats and reviews. This cannot be undone.

listingCreate.title: New listing
listingCreate.locationNote: Only your approximate location (~1 km) is saved.
listingCreate.photoTip: Tip: shoot all angles and any flaws — honest photos sell faster.
listingCreate.offersHint: Off = firm price; buyers can't send offers.
listingCreate.photoOrderTip: Tap = cover · Arrange = tap photos in your order · long-press to move to flaws
listingCreate.photoTipShort: Drag to reorder — #1 is the cover. Honest photos sell faster.

search.title: Search
search.noResults: No results — try different keywords or filters.

keywords.title: Keyword alerts
keywords.hint: Get a push notification the moment a matching listing is posted.
keywords.placeholder: e.g. IKEA desk, iPhone, rice cooker
keywords.empty: No keywords yet — add one above.

myListings.bumpCooldown: You can bump once every 24 hours.
myListings.deleteConfirm: This hides the listing permanently. Chats and reviews are kept.
myListings.noChatYet: No chat for this listing yet.
myListings.hideConfirm: It disappears for everyone else, but the record — chats and reviews — is kept.
myListings.hiddenDone: Hidden — only you can see it now

block.done: Seller blocked. You won't see their listings.

meetup.title: Pickup meetup
meetup.placeHint: Pick a busy public spot — shopping centre entrances work well.

terms.title: Before your first listing
terms.intro: A quick agreement to keep Torrens Market safe for everyone:
terms.rule1: Sell only items you own and may legally sell
terms.rule3: Honest photos & descriptions; meet in public places
terms.rule4: Reports are reviewed; violations can remove content or accounts

feedback.title: Report a problem
feedback.hint: Found a bug or have an idea? It goes straight to the maker.
feedback.placeholder: What happened? The more detail, the faster the fix.

notifPrefs.title: Notification settings
notifPrefs.hint: Choose which push notifications you receive.

trustLadder.title: Trust tiers
trustLadder.intro: Every good trade grows your Aussie animal. Points = good reviews (4–5★) minus bad ones (1–2★) from completed trades.
trustLadder.how1: · Finish the trade and mark it sold when it's done
trustLadder.how2: · Earn 4–5★ post-trade reviews from the other side
trustLadder.how3: · Keep your listings honest — bad reviews cost points

gate.reason_default: Sign in to use this feature.
gate.reason_post: Sign in to post your listing.
gate.reason_favorite: Favourites are saved to your account.
gate.reason_chat: Chat with sellers using your account.
gate.reason_report: Sign in to report or block.
gate.reason_keyword: Keyword alerts are saved to your account.

config.maintenanceBody: Torrens Market is in maintenance — browsing works, posting and chat are paused briefly.
config.updateBody: This version is no longer supported. Please update Torrens Market from the App Store.

update.storeBody: A new version of Torrens Market is on the App Store with improvements and fixes. Update to get the latest features.
update.otaBody: A small update has been downloaded. Restart the app to apply it. It only takes a moment.
update.otaFailed: Could not apply the update. It will be applied next time you open the app.

notifCenter.title: Notifications
notifCenter.empty: Nothing yet — activity on your listings shows up here.
notifCenter.kind_review_request: Purchase confirmed — leave the seller a review!

photoSource.cameraDeniedBody: Allow camera access in Settings to take photos.

flaws.title: Flaws / damage
flaws.notePlaceholder: Scratches, stains, missing parts… honesty builds trust.
flaws.defectiveNudge: Marked as having flaws — adding flaw photos or a note helps buyers trust the listing.

soldTo.title: Who did you sell to?
soldTo.body: Pick the buyer so they can leave you a review.
soldTo.reviewRequested: Marked sold — we asked the buyer for a review
